Natural and Treated Specimens
Total Weight: 2 lbs

Natural purple crystalline geode slice with deep violet terminations
Two iridescent treated quartz-style clusters with brilliant metallic finishes
Three-piece specimen lot ideal for decor, collection, or display
Diverse textures and colors ranging from earthy to prismatic

description:
Sheaffer
Ballpoint Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set - Plastic and Metal
Vintage, 2 Pieces
This Sheaffer writing set represents the classic mid-to-late 20th-century design of one of America's most storied pen manufacturers. Founded in 1912 in Fort Madison, Iowa, Sheaffer is renowned for its reliability and professional aesthetic. This set features a popular two-tone motif with vibrant blue lower barrels and polished silver-tone upper sections, finished with the iconic Sheaffer clips.
Authentic Sheaffer branding visible on pen clips and original presentation box
Set includes one ballpoint pen and one mechanical pencil
Blue plastic lower barrels with chrome-finish metal caps
Original black presentation case with red and blue accents and blue flocked interior
Condition:
Vintage used condition. The ballpoint pen features a small gold-tone monogram "AAH" on the barrel. Both pieces show light surface scratching consistent with age and use. The mechanical pencil contains lead and the mechanism is functional. The ballpoint pen ink status is not guaranteed and may require a fresh refill. The original case shows moderate exterior shelf wear with rubbing and scuffing to the corners and edges.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.

See Photos. Items sold as-is.

Orthoceras Fossil Specimen Polished Nautiloid Cephalopod Shell Display
This fossil specimen features two Orthoceras fossils embedded in a dark gray to black matrix rock. Orthoceras is an extinct genus of nautiloid cephalopod characterized by long, tapered, conical shells with visible internal chamber lines. The matrix rock is rough and unpolished on the back and sides, while the fossilized shells on the front are polished to a glossy finish, highlighting their natural details and structure. The piece is in excellent natural condition with no visible repairs, suitable for fossil collectors or natural history displays.

Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces

Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience

Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix

This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

description:
Enter The Earth / Making Memories
Natural Mineral and Fossil Specimen Collection
Geology Study Lot, Late 20th to Early 21st Century
This comprehensive geological collection features a diverse array of natural mineral specimens, fossils, and hand-carved gemstones. The lot is anchored by a 18-compartment organizer containing various rough stones including rose quartz, amethyst, jasper, and apatite, accompanied by a descriptive insert regarding Coprolite (fossilized dung). Complementing the boxed set are several larger individual display pieces and professional carvings from international sources.
Polished Pyrite sphere with "Made in Peru" label featuring natural vuggy texture
Polished Orthoceras cephalopod fossil specimen in black matrix
Amethyst geode with iridescent gold-tone titanium-treated coating
Four hand-carved stone animal figurines: Kambaba, Picture Jasper (Oregon), and Tigereye (South Africa)
Clear plastic organizer box with approximately 18 varieties of rough and tumbled mineral specimens
Condition:
Very good overall condition. Mineral specimens are in their natural rough or polished states as intended. The pyrite sphere and geode are intact with no structural cracks. The carved animals are housed in original protective plastic cases; cases show minor surface scuffing but remain functional. The main organizer box is complete and latches securely, though the lid shows typical light storage wear.
